craft_notes: Sthāyin: office-bond — chief worship owed. Rows: time, history, bond. Rejected: limb-sufficiency — killed: chief required. Read aloud: binding verse.

lines: When all rites close and the rite is gathered in, next dawn praise the master —
first pleased as the rite's limb, not as the crown:
crown him not, and the office-bond holds you bound.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sarvayāgānteṣu upasaṃhṛte yāge aparedyuḥ gurupūjāṃ kuryāt pūrvaṃ hi sa vidhyaṅgatayā toṣito na tu prādhānyena iti tāṃ prādhānyena akurvan adhikārabandhena baddho bhavati
